inputs.text: The left signal into the limiter; it is summed with the right to drive the level detector, and the channels patched here set the module's polyphony
The right signal into the limiter; it is summed with the left to drive the level detector
The level it works down to, in decibels; 0dB is the output of a standard oscillator. CV alongside

outputs.text: The left signal after limiting, held down by the same amount as the right
The right signal after limiting, held down by the same amount as the left

notes: it holds the signal below the threshold by reducing its level rather than chopping it, so it distorts far less than CLPR
menu: Attack time — a slider setting how quickly gain reduction comes in, up to 5 seconds; 150ms by default
Release time — a slider setting how quickly gain reduction backs off, up to 20 seconds; 600ms by default
Threshold range — scales what the THRESH knob covers: 1x (-24dB to 6dB) or 2x (-48dB to 12dB)
